name: Lisa Group Manager Bot
description: LisaProBot-style Telegram group management bot: federations, filters, locks, notes, reports, warns, welcome, bio-link and NSFW filters.

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric user id (get it from @userinfobot)

SUPPORT_URL.description: Support group link for the /start button

UPDATES_URL.description: Updates channel link for the /start button

SIGHTENGINE_USER.description: Optional: Sightengine API user, enables image scanning for the NSFW filter

NSFW_THRESHOLD.description: Optional: image NSFW score (0-1) above which content is removed
